title: Exploring Large Language Models Through a Neurodivergent Lens: Use, Challenges, Community-Driven Workarounds, and Concerns

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of online discussions from 61 neurodivergent subreddits (covering autism, ADHD, social anxiety, and dyslexia) to identify users' self-reported experiences and challenges with neurotypical-leaning biases in LLM responses.
